snippet.title: Greenhouse: Schism | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Find Greenhouse: Schism on Steam and Itchio!

Store Page Art & In Game Backgrounds by @RiceNoodleBrain!! :
ricenoodlebrain on Instagram!

Music by Clam Shandy (Which is still me but just my music channel!):
@ClamShandy 

And here we are at the final conclusion of the so called Greenhouse: Schism arc- The games out (Or will be shortly if you read this as the premieres description)! It's been like roughly like 11 months of development (not full time) compared to the originals 1 month hopefully that shows (•᷄__ •᷅ ;)

Thanks for reading the description ramblings if you wanted a description of the game check the steam page. It's much appreciated.
